claims.text: The hotel is located near the airport and major attractions, combining resort living with city access.

findings.quote: Ideally located near the airport and major attractions, the hotel blends serene resort living with effortless city access.
findings.note: Matches the location and the resort-plus-city-access description.

claims.text: The hotel has two outdoor pools and an indoor pool.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Dubai offers 2 outdoor pools, including one of the largest leisure pools in the city, and a 20-metre indoor pool.
findings.note: Two outdoor pools and an indoor pool are confirmed.

claims.text: Ahasees Spa and Club experiences are guided by three core philosophies: Trade, Flourish and Evolve.

findings.quote: Guided by three core philosophies — Trade, Flourish, and Evolve — each experience is thoughtfully curated to nurture the body, calm the mind, and elevate the senses.

claims.text: The fitness centre at Ahasees Spa and Club has separate zones with cardio and strength-training equipment.

findings.quote: At Ahasees Spa & Club, wellness enthusiasts can enjoy different levels of fitness activities in separate zones that feature cardio and strength-training equipment.
findings.note: Confirms separate zones with cardio and strength-training equipment.

claims.text: Skyline View rooms have Dubai skyline views and contemporary decor with Arabian touches.

findings.quote: Revel in stunning Dubai skyline views from this 39-square-metre room with contemporary decor and Arabian touches.
findings.note: From the Skyline View room descriptions.

claims.text: Rooms have an Italian bathroom with twin basins and a separate tub and shower.

findings.quote: The room features one king bed, Italian bathroom with twin basins and separate tub and shower, along with a generous work area.
findings.note: Italian bathroom with twin basins and a separate tub and shower are described for the rooms.

claims.text: Butler service is available on request in the 2 Bedroom Royal Suite.

findings.quote: dining for eight, kitchenette, wetbar, work area with minibar, complimentary high-speed internet, and marble bathroom with jetted spa bathtub, shower, and bidet. Butler service is available on request.
findings.note: From the 2 Bedroom Royal Suite description.

claims.text: Panini is a delicatessen set amid tropical indoor gardens and waterfalls, known for its strawberry cheesecake.

findings.quote: Set amid tropical indoor gardens and flowing waterfalls, Panini is a classic delicatessen offering specialty house-made breads, pastries, and gelato. Known for its signature strawberry cheesecake
findings.note: All elements of the claim are confirmed.

claims.text: Wox serves Pan-Asian street-food-inspired dishes at an intimate chef's table where the chef cooks over woks.

findings.quote: Wox draws inspiration from Pan-Asian street food and brings it to an intimate chef’s table setting. Sit close to the action as chef cooks over blazing woks
findings.note: All elements of the claim are confirmed.

claims.text: The hotel has indoor and outdoor wedding venues with personalized planning.

findings.quote: With elegant indoor and outdoor venues, personalized planning, and thoughtful details

claims.text: The hotel offers 12,500 square metres of event space, from ballrooms to meeting rooms.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Dubai offers 12,500 square metres of flexible event space, from grand ballrooms to intimate meeting rooms
findings.note: The area and the range of spaces match.

claims.text: Grand Hyatt Dubai is a city resort surrounded by 37 acres of gardens overlooking Dubai Creek.

findings.quote: a city resort surrounded by 37 acres of lush gardens overlooking the iconic Creek
findings.note: Confirms a city resort with 37 acres of gardens overlooking the Creek.

claims.text: Grand Hyatt Dubai Waterpark has 16 signature attractions and is designed for all generations.

findings.quote: Home to 16 signature attractions, Grand Hyatt Dubai Waterpark is thoughtfully designed for all generations
findings.note: The number of attractions and the all-generations design are confirmed.

claims.text: Superior rooms are adorned with Arabian influences and have views of Dubai's historic creek and parklands.

findings.quote: Unwind in a spacious 44-square-meter room adorned with Arabian influences and boasting breathtaking views of Dubai's historic creek and parklands.

claims.text: The 2 Bedroom Royal Suite has a spacious parlor, dining for eight, a kitchenette and a marble bathroom with a jetted spa bathtub.

findings.quote: A 264-square-metre two-bedroom suite with one king and two single beds, spacious parlor, dining for eight, kitchenette, wetbar, work area with minibar, complimentary high-speed internet, and marble bathroom with jetted spa bathtub

claims.text: The hotel is just outside of downtown Dubai rather than in it.

findings.quote: Stay at our luxury hotel just outside of downtown Dubai to experience the area’s best attractions.
findings.note: The hotel describes itself as just outside downtown.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing for dining and spa services.
